{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "PROMPT / WEBSITE BRIEF: Build a premium but flat-design static event landing page in Nuxt for a fitness event called “PULSE SUMMIT 2026” — a one-day urban training + wellness festival. I want it to feel like a modern GitHub-quality frontend project, clean component structure, polished responsive UI, no backend, no API, no login, no payments, no database. Static/mock content is totally fine. The site should be fully renderable as a static Nuxt website.

MAIN GOAL
Create a high-converting landing page for a fitness event with a cinematic video-background hero, strong call-to-action buttons, agenda, trainers, workout zones, ticket-style pricing cards (static only), sponsors, FAQ, and location info. The whole page should feel energetic, premium, athletic, and clear, but use FLAT design — no heavy skeuomorphism, no 3D, no WebGL, no game stuff. Think: Nike training event meets clean SaaS landing page meets modern fitness studio.

TECH / PROJECT EXPECTATION
- Use Nuxt / Vue components.
- Static site only, no server-side features needed.
- Use mock/static JSON or local arrays for speakers/trainers/schedule/pricing/FAQ.
- Good file structure like a GitHub portfolio repo: components, assets, data, layouts if needed.
- Make it easy to deploy as a static site.
- No real external APIs. If using images/video placeholders, use local placeholder paths or CSS gradients with notes.
- Please include sample content directly in the project.
- Make responsive for desktop, tablet, mobile.

STYLE DIRECTION
Brand name: PULSE SUMMIT 2026
Tagline: “Train harder. Recover smarter. Move together.”
Visual style: flat, sharp, editorial, high-energy fitness.
Palette:
- Background: deep navy / near black (#071018)
- Primary: electric lime (#B8FF2C)
- Secondary: hot coral (#FF4D5E)
- Accent: cyan blue (#30D5FF)
- Cards: dark slate (#101C26)
- Text: white / cool gray
Use strong typography, big headings, large numbers, pill labels, flat icons or icon placeholders. Avoid glassmorphism overload; subtle shadows ok but keep it flat. Use diagonal section separators or blocky graphic shapes if useful.

HERO SECTION — MUST HAVE VIDEO BACKGROUND
- Full viewport hero with muted looping background video area. Use a local/static placeholder source like /videos/fitness-hero.mp4 and add a gradient overlay so text is readable.
- If video missing, fallback should still look good with a dark gradient background.
- Nav bar at top: logo “PULSE”, links: Event, Schedule, Trainers, Tickets, FAQ.
- Big headline: “PULSE SUMMIT 2026”
- Subheadline: “A full-day fitness experience built for strength, endurance, mobility, recovery and community.”
- Date/location line: “June 20, 2026 · Austin Training Hall · 7:00 AM – 8:30 PM”
- CTAs: “View Schedule” and “Reserve Spot” (buttons scroll to sections only, no checkout)
- Add hero stats: “18 Sessions”, “12 Coaches”, “900 Athletes”, “1 Day”
- Include a small badge: “Early access passes now open” but static only.

PAGE STRUCTURE / SECTIONS
1. Sticky Navigation
- Logo, nav links, primary CTA.
- Mobile hamburger menu with simple show/hide interaction.
- Smooth scroll anchors.

2. Hero Video Background
- As above.
- Add animated but lightweight UI touches: fade in text, button hover, scroll indicator. CSS only.

3. Event Overview
Headline: “Not a conference. Not a bootcamp. A complete training day.”
Three or four flat feature cards:
- Strength Lab
- HIIT Arena
- Mobility Flow
- Recovery Lounge
Each with short copy and simple icon/emoji or flat inline SVG style. Keep it static.

4. Why Attend / Benefits
A split layout with big typography and bullets:
- Train with elite coaches
- Learn smarter recovery protocols
- Try new class formats
- Meet local gyms, brands, creators
- Leave with a practical 30-day training plan
Add an image placeholder block or pattern block.

5. Schedule / Agenda
Create a full event schedule using static data. Must look like an app-style timeline but still static.
Tabs or filters are okay but local-only front-end interaction:
- Morning
- Midday
- Afternoon
- Evening
Example sessions:
07:00 Check-in + mobility warmup
08:00 Opening HIIT wave
09:30 Strength foundations
11:00 Nutrition for performance
12:30 Community lunch break
14:00 Mobility reset
15:30 Hybrid athlete workshop
17:00 Recovery protocols
19:00 Closing team challenge
Each schedule item should show time, title, zone, coach, intensity tag.

6. Featured Trainers
Grid of 6 trainer cards with mock content:
- Maya Cruz — Strength & Conditioning
- Jordan Lee — HIIT Coach
- Ava Brooks — Mobility Specialist
- Theo Mason — Endurance Coach
- Nina Patel — Recovery Therapist
- Marcus Stone — Hybrid Athlete Coach
Cards should have image placeholders, specialty tags, short bios, social handle text only (not linked to real APIs).

7. Workout Zones
Create an attractive section with four zone cards:
- The Arena: HIIT, sweat, music, crowd energy
- Iron Deck: strength, barbells, coaching cues
- Flow Room: yoga, mobility, breathwork
- Reset Bar: stretching, massage chairs, hydration
Add capacity numbers and difficulty labels.

8. Ticket / Pass Cards (STATIC ONLY)
No checkout, no payment. Just design pricing cards with CTA that scrolls to contact/info or says “Reserve Spot”.
Cards:
- Starter Pass — $49 — access to expo + 2 sessions
- Athlete Pass — $89 — full day access + workshops
- VIP Recovery Pass — $149 — full day + recovery lounge + swag kit
Include feature lists, highlight Athlete Pass as most popular.
Add note: “Demo landing page — pricing content is static.”

9. Event Countdown
Add a visual countdown component but it can be static or client-side only calculating date locally. No server. If simpler, create styled boxes showing days/hours/minutes with sample numbers. Make clear it’s decorative.

10. Sponsors / Partners
Static logo grid with fake brand names, e.g.
- LIFT LAB
- HYDR8
- CORE WEAR
- MOTION CLUB
- RECOVERLY
- URBAN RUNNERS
Use text logos only, flat blocks.

11. Venue / Location
Section title: “Austin Training Hall”
Add static address text and details:
- 2100 Riverside Fitness Blvd, Austin, TX
- Indoor/outdoor training zones
- Lockers, showers, water stations
- Parking and bike racks available
No real map API. Use a stylized static map placeholder made with divs/CSS.

12. Testimonials
3 short static testimonials from imaginary attendees. Example:
“Best training event I’ve ever attended — intense, organized, and actually useful.”
Include names and roles.

13. FAQ
Accordion interaction front-end only.
Questions:
- Do I need to be advanced?
- What should I bring?
- Are meals included?
- Can I switch sessions?
- Is this website connected to registration?
For last answer say registration is represented by static CTA buttons for this demo.

14. Final CTA
Big closing section with strong text:
“Ready to move with the city?”
Buttons: “See Schedule” “Choose Pass”
Add short reminder of date/location.

15. Footer
Links, mini logo, event info, fake social labels, copyright 2026. Keep simple.

INTERACTIONS REQUIRED
- Mobile menu open/close.
- Smooth anchor scrolling.
- Schedule time-of-day tabs or simple category filter using local state only.
- FAQ accordion.
- CTA buttons scroll to corresponding sections.
- Video background should autoplay muted loop playsinline where possible.
No authentication, no forms that submit to server. If contact/signup is shown, make it a static visual input only or omit submission.

RESPONSIVE REQUIREMENTS
- Desktop: wide hero, multi-column cards, sticky nav.
- Tablet: 2-column grids.
- Mobile: single column, readable headline, video overlay not too busy, sticky CTA optional.
- Ensure contrast and accessibility: semantic headings, alt text for placeholders, focus states, keyboard friendly buttons.

CONTENT TONE
Energetic, concise, premium. Not too corporate. Use fitness language: reps, recovery, endurance, strength, mobility, community.

DELIVERABLE
Please create the Nuxt static landing page with all major components and styling. It should look complete even with placeholder images/video. Include enough mock content so the page feels like a real event site. Use clean CSS, no backend dependencies, and keep the implementation ready for GitHub review.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
